question: How should the head be ritually cleansed during this procedure?
premises: Water from the sprinkling vessel is used
Kuśa grasses serve as the instrument
The head is the object of cleansing
inference: One should wipe the head with kuśa grasses and water from the sprinkling vessel.
plain_english: One should wipe the head with kuśa grasses using water from the sprinkling vessel.
